title: HydrationPolicy
description: Rules governing bounded on-demand memory hydration and prompt eviction (IPCF-1.1).

max_rehydration_tokens_per_call.description: Reference default: 3000 tokens. IPCF Invariant 4 requires bounded rehydration (the cap MUST exist and be enforced); the specific threshold is a deployment policy — implementors MAY override this value. Any override must be documented in the implementation's conformance profile.

scope.description: Strict boundary: hydrated payload exists in LLM context only for the active turn.

eviction_trigger.description: Enforced eviction: hydrated payload is automatically pruned from prompt on next user turn.

integrity_verification.description: Verify SHA-256 hash against recall index before hydrating payload into prompt.
